subject: Half-hour walkthrough request — propose three tight windows
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@sierrasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Half-hour walkthrough request — propose three tight windows

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the discovery earlier — really helpful to understand Sierra's ingestion volume and the latency targets you mentioned. Quick recap from my side:

- Current priority: reduce average inference latency under 150ms for customer-facing features while controlling per-token cost.
- Key constraint: onboarding must meet your security checklist (SSO + retention controls) and support multi-region routing.
- Success metric for pilot: 2x improvement in tail latency during peak traffic and a cost model that fits within your Q4 budget envelope.

We're ready to do a short, focused product walkthrough (30 minutes) that covers: runtime overview, a short live demo of a 1-2 feature flow, and next steps for a pilot. To keep this tight for your team, can you pick one of these narrow windows (all PDT):

1) Thu Sep 18 — 09:00–09:30
2) Thu Sep 18 — 11:00–11:30
3) Fri Sep 19 — 10:30–11:00

If none of those work, tell me two 30-minute bands that do and I’ll coordinate with engineering. Please also let me know if you want Marcus (VP Eng) or your security lead on the call — if so, we’ll loop in Marissa (CS) and Grace (Solutions Engineer) from our side.

Attached: redwood-platform-onepager.pdf for quick reading.

Proposed agenda (short):
- 5m quick intros & goals
- 15m demo: runtime + routing + metrics
- 8m pilot approach, roles, next steps
- 2m Q&A / scheduling follow-ups

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@sierrasys.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@sierrasys.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Half-hour walkthrough request — propose three tight windows

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the recap, that matches what we discussed. I can do Thu Sep 18 at 11:00–11:30 (window #2) or Fri Sep 19 at 10:30–11:00, prefer the Thu slot. Marcus is looped in — he may try to join the entire call or hop in for the demo segment.

A few quick asks before the walkthrough:
- Can you surface how SSO (Okta) would look in a Private deployment vs Hosted?
- We also need a short note on data residency options (EU vs US) — Marcus will want that in writing.

I’ve CC'd Marissa to help coordinate the mutual action plan. If you could add a short one-pager on security controls and the list of typical pilot resources that would be great.

Best,
Alice
Alice Gomez | Head of Product Integrations, Sierra Systems
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@sierrasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace OConnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Half-hour walkthrough request — propose three tight windows

Perfect — locking Thu Sep 18 11:00–11:30 PDT for the walkthrough. I’ve added Marissa and Grace to the thread; Grace will run the demo and can speak to private deployment options and SSO integration.

Quick next actions from our side:
- I attached a short security summary and the mutual action plan template (mutual-action-plan-template.xlsx).
- Grace will prepare a 5-slide appendix on Okta SSO flows and a one-paragraph note on regional data residency options (US/EU).
- We’ll put together a pilot resource list (typical infra and SME time) and share that in the HubSpot record.

HubSpot link for the deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/6789

Agenda update (final):
- 5m intros & goals (Alice + Marcus + Marissa + Vivek + Grace)
- 15m demo: runtime behavior, KV/prefix caching, routing policy example
- 7m pilot scoping & next steps (mutual action plan roles)
- 3m security/residency Q&A

Grace (grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com) — can you confirm the demo machine we'll use and the short doc on Okta? Also attaching the one-pager for Alice.

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite once Alice confirms final attendees.

— Vivek
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@sierrasys.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@sierrasys.com>, Grace OConnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Half-hour walkthrough request — propose three tight windows

Thanks Vivek — Thu Sep 18 11:00–11:30 PDT works and Marcus will join for the demo. I’ll send the calendar invite from my side in the next 20 minutes and include our security lead if Marcus thinks that’s necessary.

Appreciate the one-pager and the MAP template. Looking forward to the walkthrough — please include the demo link and dial-in in the invite.

Regards,
Alice
